handoff_rule.what: Rule: keep one handoff note in auto memory, updated on wrap-up phrases, pushes and ::handoff
handoff_rule.used: a working session (3+ prompts) that starts with a handoff reads it within its first 3 prompts

passing_facts_rule.what: Rule: save lasting project facts the user mentions in passing
passing_facts_rule.used: no cheap measure: facts in index lines are never Read. Judged by the canary and by junk notes the user deletes

staleness_nudge.what: Stop line: new commits since the session started, but the handoff note is older than the latest
staleness_nudge.used: the handoff note is written later in the same session

sync.what: Three-way sync of auto memory folders through the git store, keyed by git remote
sync.used: notes arrive with new content from another machine
